title: Evaluate Confidence Instead of Perplexity for Zero-shot Commonsense Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the relationship between word frequency and model inference scores by comparing traditional perplexity metrics against a proposed Non-Replacement Confidence (NRC) metric on commonsense reasoning datasets (e.g., COPA, ARC), specifically analyzing how models overestimate high-frequency words and underestimate low-frequency words.
